title: AI交易输家：竟是超大规模企业，少花钱反而利好谁？
speaker: Helen Zhu

segments.en: When it comes to the AI trade, you just talked about how the picks and shovels trade maybe went a bit too far.
segments.zh: 谈到AI交易，你刚才提到卖铲子的交易可能有点过头了。

segments.en: But what else are you seeing in terms of maybe is this a chance to pick things up a little bit, especially when it comes to the labs?
segments.zh: 但你还看到其他什么机会吗？比如这是不是捡漏的机会，尤其是对实验室来说？

segments.en: I mean, not just what's coming out of the US, but parts of Asia as well.
segments.zh: 不只是美国的情况，亚洲部分地区也是如此。

segments.en: Do you think there is enough of that sort of infrastructure in there to benefit labs or other AI plays in the like?
segments.zh: 你认为那里有足够的基础设施让实验室或其他AI参与者受益吗？

segments.en: Well, don't get me wrong. AI play is not just picks and shovels, so that is what has actually worked within the ecosystem historically over the last year, year and a half.
segments.zh: 别误会，AI交易不只是卖铲子，过去一年半里生态系统中真正奏效的就是这个。

segments.en: But that's not the entire trade. You've got to think about that.
segments.zh: 但这不是全部交易，你得想想这一点。

segments.en: The losers recently have been actually the hyperscalers, the people that have been investing, and the winners are the people that are getting all the,
segments.zh: 最近的输家其实是超大规模企业，那些一直在**的公司，而赢家是那些获得所有……

segments.en: you know, trillions, more than one trillion per year of capex from that investing.
segments.zh: 你知道，每年超过一万亿美元的资本开支来自这种**。

segments.en: So if there's a little bit less investment versus before, then that's potentially positive for the hyperscalers or the ones who are investing.
segments.zh: 所以如果**比之前少一点，那对超大规模企业或市场参与者来说可能是积极的。

segments.en: What we also see is that for the models themselves, because of the component prices surging and the inability to secure compute, you know,
segments.zh: 我们还看到，对于模型本身，由于组件价格飙升和无法获得算力，你知道……

segments.en: they were having some concerns regarding the ROI and the market was worrying that their revenue momentum wasn't fierce enough.
segments.zh: 他们对回报率有些担忧，市场担心其收入增长势头不够强劲。

segments.en: So maybe if component prices drop and they have to spend a little bit less per gigawatt or a little bit less per token generation, that's potentially positive for them as well.
segments.zh: 所以如果组件价格下降，他们每吉瓦或每token生成的花费能少一点，这对他们可能也是有利的。

segments.en: And moreover, if token prices start to come down more meaningfully just with technology improvement and competition and all of these things, then it's certainly positive
segments.zh: 此外，如果token价格因技术进步和竞争等因素开始更明显地下行，那肯定是有利的。

segments.en: for the ecosystem, positive for companies, in terms of adoption and less worries about token maxing, positive for consumer adoption as well.
segments.zh: 对生态系统有利，对公司有利，采用率提升，对token消耗过度的担忧减少，对消费者采用也有利。

segments.en: So all of these things will actually potentially benefit and that could mean some downstream applications companies, either in the early stage or the more mature ones as well.
segments.zh: 所以所有这些都可能带来益处，这可能意味着一些下游应用公司，无论是早期阶段还是更成熟的公司。

segments.en: So there are going to be other winners and the AI trade will be less, you know, single-faceted versus what we have seen in the past.
segments.zh: 所以会有其他赢家，AI交易将不像我们过去看到的那样单一。

segments.en: Is there any, for hedges then, for an extreme reason?
segments.zh: 那么，是否有任何对冲手段来应对极端情况？
